summary: Good Python implementation (type hints, proper exception handling, clean architecture) and well-designed workflow YAML (pinned actions, least-privilege permissions, job outputs/dependencies). However, ~50% of deliverable is missing and required: no test file (red/green TDD mandated), no fixture files (JUnit XML/JSON samples required), no act-based test harness with validation. Workflow has no steps to populate RESULTS_DIR, run tests, or verify outputs—just runs aggregator on undefined data. Task explicitly requires: 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT', 'act-result.txt file MUST exist', actionlint validation. None present. Cannot be validated locally.
